timing_note: Sequential batch-one message requests. Positive and actual opposition passes timed separately; warmup excluded. Includes tokenization/schema preparation. No HTTP or container overhead.

gliner_original.instructions: Does the sender request BOTH of two independent actions, rather than one action or alternatives? Count different requests, not link steps or multiple data fields. An explicit opt-out counts; advertising alone does not request purchase.

criteria.true: Yes, it asks for two or more distinct actions.
criteria.false: No, it asks for at most one distinct action.

gliner_balanced.instructions: Is there more than one independent explicit task requested together? Include optional opt-outs. Exclude alternatives, inferred purchases, navigation/transport, fields of one submission and steps of one payment. Shared purpose alone does not merge a call and installation.

criteria.true: Yes, it asks for two or more distinct actions.
criteria.false: No, it asks for at most one distinct action.

gliner_direct_choice.instructions: Count independent operations explicitly requested of the recipient. Include invitations and optional opt-outs. Do not count factual information, available benefits, negated requests, sender actions, or alternatives as extra tasks. Navigation, reply transport, multiple fields and payment steps belong to one task. Two separate requests of the same category can be two tasks.

criteria.single_or_none: Zero or one independent recipient operation is requested.
criteria.multiple: At least two independent recipient operations are requested together.

gliner_direct_three.instructions: Count independent operations explicitly requested of the recipient. Include invitations and optional opt-outs. Do not count factual information, available benefits, negated requests, sender actions, or alternatives as extra tasks. Navigation, reply transport, multiple fields and payment steps belong to one task. Two separate requests of the same category can be two tasks. Either/or alternatives count as one task. Calling support then installing a tool count as two tasks.

criteria.zero_tasks: No recipient task is explicitly requested.
criteria.one_task: One recipient task is requested, including its steps or alternatives.
criteria.multiple_tasks: At least two distinct recipient tasks are requested together.
